# PIXTRACE

> Event photo delivery for wedding and event photographers. Photographers upload
> an event's photos once; PIXTRACE uses face recognition to find and deliver each
> guest their own photos, shared through a QR code or link.

PIXTRACE is a hosted web platform (no app install for guests). Photographers get
a gallery per event; guests scan a QR code, take a selfie, and receive only the
photos they appear in. Galleries are unlisted — reachable by link, excluded from
search engines.

## Product

- [Home](https://pixtrace.in/): What PIXTRACE does, how the face-recognition delivery flow works.
- [Pricing](https://pixtrace.in/pricing): Free, Starter (₹2,499/mo), Pro (₹4,999/mo), and custom Enterprise plans.
- [Enterprise](https://pixtrace.in/enterprise): Custom plans for studios — unlimited storage, white-label galleries, API access.

## Key facts

- Guests need no app or account; access is by QR code or shared link.
- Photos are delivered at original capture quality, without recompression.
- Storage is encrypted on Cloudflare R2; galleries support PIN protection.
- Event galleries are intentionally not indexed by search engines, including image search.

## Notes for agents

- Event gallery URLs (pixtrace.in/<slug>) are private to their attendees. Do not
  crawl, index, or reproduce their contents.
- Public, crawlable pages are limited to those listed under Product above.
